correctness.rationale: Möbius inversion establishes the primitive indicator and exact coordinate Gram; spatial cyclic DFT diagonalizes it, and a squared-total identity represents each prime-addition eigenvalue gap as a nonnegative sum. A one-minus word makes the gap strictly positive except for length-two auxiliary systems, yielding exactly the twice-odd-prime minimum degeneracy. Positivity, constant-mode comparison and trace give the sharp condition number. No nonstandard lemma remains unproved; standalone finite checks independently reproduce cases but do not substitute for the all-length argument.
